server.Rd

This function is the main server "function" with all of the logic

Usage

server(input, output)

Arguments

input

the user input to the server to be processed

output

the corresponding output to be displayed

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
} # }
